subject.title: feat: add lease-bound metadata to session spawns

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a generic core lease-authorized session-spawn extension seam, or should the Agentic OS-specific contract remain in its downstream owner integration?
rationale: The patch adds a new externally visible Gateway and persistence contract, and selecting its permanent owner/API shape is a product and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Require an owner-neutral core seam
options.body: Sponsor a narrowly documented generic plugin SDK/Gateway extension point, then rework the contract to use it without Agentic OS policy in core.

options.title: Keep it downstream
options.body: Close or substantially narrow the core PR and implement the contract in the Agentic OS owner repository using existing supported seams.

options.title: Accept the named core contract
options.body: Explicitly approve Agentic OS as a permanent core Gateway and persisted-state surface, including its upgrade and API support obligations.

recommendation.title: Require an owner-neutral core seam
recommendation.body: Sponsor a narrowly documented generic plugin SDK/Gateway extension point, then rework the contract to use it without Agentic OS policy in core.

likelyOwner.reason: A current Gateway/session code-history owner could not be established without guessing from unavailable local history output.
